purpose: Extend the legacy among-taxon environmental-PCA permutation analysis from the nine primary endpoints to the complete measured GEB v2 inferential trait universe.

environment.taxon_summary: median across frozen strict spatial observations
environment.pca_fit_scope: common taxa satisfying the replication rule for every measured inferential endpoint

primary_scope.permutation_rule: shuffle the taxon trait values among the same common taxa while holding environmental PCA fixed

circular_hue.statistic: multivariate explained-sum-of-squares fraction for standardized sine/cosine regressed jointly on environmental PC1-PC3
circular_hue.permutation_rule: shuffle paired sine/cosine taxon values among the same common taxa

multiplicity.linear_metrics: Benjamini-Hochberg separately for primary and candidate tiers and separately for centroid and overlap tests within each replication scope
multiplicity.circular_hue: reported as one joint test per replication scope

claim_boundary: Environmental sorting among source-assigned taxa is not within-taxon response.
Taxon-label permutation is not phylogenetic correction.
Low/high quartiles are a statistical contrast for continuous linear traits, not biological categories.
Circular hue is never converted to ordered colour quartiles.
Candidate image-derived traits remain exploratory until botanical validation.
